title: FY 2025 Survey
fullTitle: Higher Education Research and Development (HERD) Survey
changesNote: There were no changes to this questionnaire from the FY 2024 version.

content.html: This survey collects data on research and development (R&D) activities at higher education institutions. Please report R&D activities and expenditures for your institution's 2025 fiscal year.

content.text: Please report data for your institution's 2025 fiscal year.

R&D activity is creative and systematic work undertaken in order to increase the stock of knowledge — including knowledge of humankind, culture, and society — and to devise new applications of available knowledge. R&D covers three activities: basic research, applied research, and experimental development.

items.text: is experimental or theoretical work undertaken primarily to acquire new knowledge of the underlying foundations of phenomena and observable facts, without any particular application or use in view.
is original investigation undertaken in order to acquire new knowledge. It is directed primarily towards a specific, practical aim or objective.

is systematic work, drawing on knowledge gained from research and practical experience and producing additional knowledge, which is directed to producing new products or processes or to improving existing products or processes.

content.text: At the end of each survey cycle, we send a thank-you letter to the president/chancellor of each institution that completes the survey. In that letter, we acknowledge the person listed as the primary contact. If there are other individuals who should also be thanked in the letter, please let us know in the box below. sections.title: R&D expenditures by source of funds

content.text: How much of your total expenditures for research and development (R&D) came from the following sources in FY 2025?

content.html:
• In rows a, b, c, d, and f: Include both direct and recovered indirect costs (reimbursement of F&A costs from external sponsors).
  • Report the original source of funds, when possible.
  • Funds coming through your institution's 501(c)3 should be reported based on the original funding source (e.g., restricted gifts in row f; unrestricted gifts in row e).
  • Include all fields of R&D (e.g., sciences, engineering, humanities, education, law, arts). See full listing in Question 9.

content.label: U.S. federal government
description: Any agency of the United States government.
Include federal funds passed through from another institution. Funds from FFRDCs should be treated as direct federal funding.

content.label: State and local government
description: Any state, county, municipality, or other local government entity in the United States, including state health agencies.
Include state funds that support R&D at agricultural and other experiment stations.
Public institutions should report state appropriations restricted for R&D activities here rather than in row e, Institutional funds.

content.label: Business
description: Domestic or foreign for-profit organizations. Report funds from a company's nonprofit foundation in row d.

content.label: Nonprofit organizations
description: Domestic or foreign nonprofit foundations and organizations, except universities and colleges. Funds from other universities and colleges should be reported in row f.

children.label: Institutionally financed research
description: Separately accounted for R&D funded by your institution. Do not include estimated research time. Exclude institution research administration and support (e.g., office of sponsored programs) or other indirect costs.

children.text: Did you include the following types of funding in your responses to Question 1, row e1?

items.label: Competitively awarded internal grants for research
items.description: Expenditures for organized research projects, involving a proposal or statement of work with expected research outcomes.

items.label: Startup packages/bridge funding/seed funding
items.description: Expenditures from funds provided to faculty members to begin or continue their research while seeking external sponsors.

items.label: Other departmental funds designated for research
items.description: Expenditures for research from other departmental or central accounts which do not match the descriptions provided in rows a or b.

items.label: Tuition assistance for student research personnel
items.description: University tuition assistance, waivers, or remission provided to students working on organized research. Please check "Included" even if these funds are reported as part of the expenditures included under rows a, b, or c.

children.label: Cost sharing
description: Include committed cost sharing other than unrecovered indirect costs.

children.label: Unrecovered indirect costs
description: Calculate for externally funded R&D only (preferably on a project-specific basis) using the appropriate cost rate — on-campus, off-campus, etc.
bullets: First, multiply the negotiated rate by the corresponding base.

content.label: All other sources
description: Other sources not reported above, such as funds from foreign governments, foreign or U.S. universities, and gifts designated by the donors for research.

content.text: This item is confidential. Please see the confidentiality statement on page 4.
Totals for rows e4 and g are automatically generated on the Web survey.
How much of the total R&D expenditures reported in Question 1, row g, originated from the following foreign sources?

content.html: • Expenditures funded by domestic sources that passed through a foreign source should not be reported on this question.

content.label: Foreign government
description: All levels of foreign government, including national, regional, municipality, or other local government.

content.label: Business
description: Foreign for-profit organizations. Projects sponsored by a U.S. location of a foreign company are not considered foreign. Report funds from a company's nonprofit foundation in row c.

content.label: Nonprofit organizations
description: Foreign nonprofit foundations and organizations, except higher education institutions. Funds from foreign universities should be reported in row d.

content.label: Higher education
description: Foreign colleges and universities and units owned, operated, and controlled by such institutions.

content.label: All other sources
description: Include international governmental organizations located in the U.S., such as the United Nations, the World Bank, and the International Monetary Fund and all other entities sending funds to the U.S. from a location outside the U.S. and its territories.
